title: edna-ont-nf pipeline parameters
description: ONT mixed-amplicon classification pipeline: quality-aware clustering (isONclust) + spoa/racon/medaka consensus + reference/BLAST taxonomy assignment.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Samplesheet CSV with two columns: sample,fastq.
input.help_text: Each row maps a sample name to a fastq file or glob (e.g. `data/barcode17/*.fastq.gz`). A glob may match multiple part-files -- they're merged into one file per sample before filtering. Glob paths resolve relative to the launch directory, not the samplesheet's own location.

taxdb.help_text: A BLAST db is (re)built from this file at the start of every run, so the reference set can be updated without a separate makeblastdb step.

outdir.description: Output directory where results are published.

primer_trimming.title: Primer trimming
primer_trimming.description: cutadapt primer trimming -- skipped entirely if left unset.

fwd_primer.help_text: IUPAC nucleotide codes only (ACGTU + ambiguity codes WSMKRYBDHVN). Case-insensitive.

rev_primer.help_text: IUPAC nucleotide codes only (ACGTU + ambiguity codes WSMKRYBDHVN). Case-insensitive.

cluster_id.help_text: Tune per amplicon/primer set -- too loose merges distinct species into one cluster, too strict splits one species into many clusters.

min_cluster.description: Minimum reads in a cluster required to attempt consensus.

enable_medaka.description: Use the medaka-polished consensus instead of the racon consensus downstream.
enable_medaka.help_text: Off by default: the racon consensus is used directly as the final consensus for BLAST and reporting. When enabled, MEDAKA runs as an additional ONT-specific polishing step and its output replaces the racon consensus everywhere downstream.

taxonomy_assignment.title: Taxonomy assignment
taxonomy_assignment.description: BLAST-based taxonomy assignment and confidence flagging.

min_pident.description: BLAST %identity threshold for a confident call.
min_pident.help_text: Hits below this identity are flagged low_identity rather than dropped, and routed to consensus_by_confidence/low_confidence/ instead of confident/. Clusters with no BLAST hit at all are flagged no_hit.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options, typically left at their defaults.

help.description: Display the help message and exit.

tracedir.description: Directory for the Nextflow timeline/report/trace files.
